builtins.name: studio_get_state
builtins.description: Read project identity/revision, selection, playback, jobs and UI preferences. Read this before an edit and pass its context to mutations.

builtins.name: studio_audio_levels
builtins.description: Read live stereo sample-peak/RMS dBFS levels after track gain, regions and effects, before player listening volume. $mix is the summed final mix before export clipping. Reset clears latched clipping and maxima for one track ID or all tracks when id is omitted. This never changes project audio or gain.

builtins.name: studio_get_project
builtins.description: Read the complete saved project JSON. For partial changes prefer the typed editing tools or atomic project patches.

builtins.name: studio_get_dialogues
builtins.description: Read paginated dialogue texts, translation statuses, selected takes and timing. Maximum 200 rows per response.

builtins.name: studio_microphone
builtins.description: Record a local microphone take for a dialogue in the open studio. status/start/stop/discard/save. start may require the Windows microphone permission prompt; max 120 seconds. save adds an immutable take. Existing takes stay intact.

builtins.name: studio_save
builtins.description: Flush pending desktop edits to disk. No project change is discarded.

builtins.name: studio_project_patch
builtins.description: Atomically apply JSON Pointer patches to the current project with validation and undo. add/replace/remove/test supported; Project identity/revision/creation metadata cannot be overwritten. Use test for array IDs. All character, reference, pronunciation, model, subtitle, track and lip settings are editable. Read studio://schemas/Project for the full schema.

builtins.name: studio_edit_dialogue
builtins.description: Edit source/translated/spoken text; optionally validate the translation. lineId must exist.

builtins.name: studio_retime_dialogue
builtins.description: Set subtitle timing for source, target or both without moving other lines.

builtins.name: studio_split_dialogue
builtins.description: Split a subtitle dialogue at a time in milliseconds.

builtins.name: studio_merge_dialogue
builtins.description: Merge a dialogue with its following dialogue.

builtins.name: studio_move_voice
builtins.description: Move the selected generated voice relative to its dialogue. Offset is signed milliseconds. Rejects overlaps and film boundaries.

builtins.name: studio_resize_voice
builtins.description: Change the generated voice duration while preserving pitch, within the actual free timeline slot.

builtins.name: studio_edit_voice
builtins.description: Cut, add silence, stretch, set gain, apply fades or replace an audio effects chain on a generated take. Its original WAV is preserved. Render is checked before committing.

builtins.name: studio_set_track
builtins.description: Change track mute, solo and global gain independently. Global gains range from zero to four (0–400%), independently of region gains.

builtins.name: studio_audio_region
builtins.description: Paint a gain/mute interval on any audio track, preserving surrounding portions.

builtins.name: studio_remove_audio_region
builtins.description: Remove a saved gain/mute region on an audio track.

builtins.name: studio_set_all_audio
builtins.description: Quickly mute or unmute all audio, or one track when trackId is provided.

builtins.name: studio_select_take
builtins.description: Choose a generated voice take for playback and export.

builtins.name: studio_delete_take
builtins.description: Remove a take from the project; native source files are never overwritten by this edit. Undo remains available.

builtins.name: studio_review_take
builtins.description: Validate or invalidate a dialogue voice take.

builtins.name: studio_set_lip_variant
builtins.description: Enable or disable a retouched clip after checking that it matches the current voice and timing.

builtins.name: studio_select_dialogue
builtins.description: Select and reveal a dialogue in the desktop timeline.

builtins.name: studio_set_selection
builtins.description: Check a list of dialogue IDs for a batch. This replaces the current checked list.

builtins.name: studio_playback
builtins.description: Control synchronized playback or audition an original/generated reply. Use pause/stop to end playback; seek uses milliseconds.

builtins.name: studio_preferences
builtins.description: Control interface language/theme, selected panel, loop padding and timeline zoom. No arbitrary code or shell commands.

builtins.name: studio_updates
builtins.description: Read or check for an app update, start its signed download, change automatic checks, or install a downloaded update. Install requires all processing jobs to finish, saves the project and restarts the app. Download/install return accepted status; poll studio_get_state.updater.
